name: reconstitution
wording: a session, new or compacted, recovering from records, never memory: the design state of the contexts it touches, the delivered workflow included, and the decisions its work needs, from the concept journal; the work in flight and how it ended from version control and the lead's outcomes; nothing recorded or changed before its read-back
reason: The operator: each concept is an address plus a correction: the most precise established name as read within its bounded context, and a residue holding only the symmetric difference, its relations each stated once where owned, in the dense form of the canon's own values; the earlier restatement put the name before prose restating what the name already invokes, kept episodes and missed established names.
